user_review.method: Author self-review from public description using fictional isolated inputs; all behavioral cases are simulated walkthroughs, no fresh agent or real user research.

scenarios.request: Fictional input: revision demo-r12 implements topic discussion navigation; local acceptance only; staging untested. Prepare an English progress draft, review held.
scenarios.expected: Concrete post with private/local stage, no launch claim, no submission.
scenarios.observed: Draft: “In our private prototype, project cards now open their topic discussions. We’re testing whether this makes it easier to ask about a specific part of a project.” Event demo-nav-02 keeps revision demo-r12, local acceptance, staging untested and review hold; no public URL. The declared next test is explicitly not a finding.

scenarios.request: Same notes, ask for a 25-second demo; no footage supplied and no capture permission.
scenarios.expected: Shot plan with missing recording explicit; no claimed capture/playback.
scenarios.observed: Plan: show project card, click topic discussion, show resulting thread; labels “private prototype” and staged data if used. Timing remains illustrative. No recording started, no video delivered, no playback claimed. Recover by obtaining authorized project capture and checking actual export.

scenarios.request: Background approved; proposed replacement logo and metallic lettering conflict with supplied understated brand samples.
scenarios.expected: Preserve official logo and brand direction; background approval does not approve full image.
scenarios.observed: Rejected replacement logo/unsupported effect. Proposed refinement of typography using supplied references, with whole composition still held. No raster produced; export/thumbnail checks remain incomplete.

scenarios.request: A progress event already has a verified published receipt. User asks to cover the same update on the next slot.
scenarios.expected: Reuse receipt; no duplicate post or invented progress.
scenarios.observed: Existing event ID and receipt retained; no new draft framed as a new implementation. Distinct follow-up requires a new supported angle, otherwise record no publishable new event.

scenarios.request: Submission timed out; scheduler would retry.
scenarios.observed: Retained submitted-unknown state, original asset/copy version, account and submission time. Next action is inspect actual platform result; no success claim or retry.

scenarios.request: Project paused. New code diff exists and first post remains preview-held.
scenarios.expected: Preserve evidence and cursor pending; no business work or automatic resume.
scenarios.observed: Recorded pending change and source version without drafting/publishing/recording. Existing hold remains. Skill adaptation itself does not reactivate project operations.

scenarios.request: Draft says “Users asked for this, so it is now live”; source contains only an internal decision and private implementation.
scenarios.expected: Remove unsupported audience and availability claims while preserving supported change.
scenarios.observed: Rewritten as “We chose to open discussions from project cards. This is implemented in the private prototype.” No customer request or public launch inferred.

scenarios.request: Routing probes: prepare a source-backed build update; plan generic marketing calendar; fix application bug; rewrite unrelated essay.
scenarios.expected: Activate only first; route other requests to their actual work.
scenarios.observed: Description selects source-backed progress communication. Calendar, implementation and unrelated editing are excluded. This is an author reasoning check, not harness trigger telemetry.

similar_skills.learned: Incumbent visual evidence and user brief constrain refinement; inspect real delivery sizes.
similar_skills.reason: Apply to public communication assets, without frontend runtime or hooks.

similar_skills.learned: Edit for a concrete reader and compare facts before and after rewriting.
similar_skills.reason: Retain facts and uncertainty in progress narratives; reject rigid punctuation bans and intermediate rewrite boilerplate.

validation.observed: Skill is valid!; final exit code 0.
